_comment: Encounter HIGHLIGHT feel (see include/Glimmer.h): a lit rim around the thing itself, beating so it reads as selectable. A spot is lit while it's the active target -- in reach AND faced, or hovered -- and nothing lingers once you turn away. How far 'in reach' is lives in psyche.json (interact_reach). Items wear the same rim, steady, through config/world_items.json. Tunable -- edit + relaunch (dev reads assets from source).
_brightness_comment: perception_scales hands the dial to the Perception formula (config/formulas.json) -- the world through the character's eyes. Off while the feel is being tuned: every spot lights flat at `brightness`. Flip it back on to restore the stat-driven read.
